source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 2 exercise hal (PDF 43-45): MCQs ke jawab aur wajah, short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab, Kitab ki ghalti aur Wazahat boxes.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Atomic Structure) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ka sahi jawab aur wajah di gayi hai; short aur descriptive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain. Diagram wale sawalon (short n, Q.4) mein drawing lafzon mein bayan ki gayi hai. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain (MCQ X-XII chapter 3 se).
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)
Q.1 Har sawal ke chaar jawab diye gaye hain. Sahi jawab chunein.

blocks.prompt:
I. The quantum number ‘m’ of a free gaseous atom is associated with:
(Azad gas atom ka quantum number 'm' kis cheez se mutaliq hai?)

options.text: magnetic field na hone par orbital ki energy

blocks.explanation: Magnetic quantum number m orbital ka space mein rukh batata hai (2.5.3); n size aur energy, ℓ shakal batata hai.

blocks.prompt:
II. When 3d subshell is completely filled, the next entering electron goes into:
(Jab 3d subshell poora bhar jaye to agla electron kahan jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bharne ki tarteeb: … 4s < 3d < 4p < 5s … (n + ℓ rule). 4s pehle hi 3d se pehle bhar chuka hota hai, is liye 3d¹⁰ ke baad agla electron 4p mein jata hai (misal Ga: 3d¹⁰ 4s² 4p¹) (2.7.2).

blocks.prompt:
III. Quantum number values for 2p orbitals are:
(2p orbitals ke quantum numbers kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: 2 ka matlab n = 2 aur p ka matlab ℓ = 1 (2.5.2). n = 1 ke liye ℓ sirf 0 ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt:
IV. An electron having the set of values: n = 4, l = 0, m = 0 and s = +1/2 lies in:
(n = 4, l = 0, m = 0, s = +1/2 wala electron kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: n = 4 chautha shell aur ℓ = 0 s subshell hai, is liye electron 4s mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
V. The quantum number values for the fourth electron of ⁹₄Be atom are:
(⁹₄Be atom ke chauthe electron ke quantum numbers kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Be = 1s² 2s². Chautha electron doosra 2s electron hai: n = 2, ℓ = 0, m = 0 (aur s = −½).

blocks.prompt:
VI. The correct order of first ionization energies is:
(Pehli ionization energies ki sahi tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: He (poora bhara 1s, noble gas) sab se zyada; F zyada (chhota atom, zyada nuclear charge); N (half-filled 2p, 1403) O (paired 2p⁴) se zyada; Mg (bara, period 3) sab se kam (1.7.3, 2.3.2). Yani He > F > N > O > Mg.

blocks.prompt:
VII. A p orbital has a characteristic shape with how many lobes?
(p orbital ki shakal mein kitne lobes (hisse) hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: p orbital dumb-bell jaisa hai: apne axis par do lobes, beech mein nucleus (2.6.2).

blocks.prompt:
VIII. The three p orbitals in a given energy level are oriented:
(Aik energy level ke teen p orbitals ka rukh kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: x, y aur z axes par aik doosre ke amudi (perpendicular).

blocks.explanation: ℓ = 1 se m = −1, 0, +1: teen orbitals px, py, pz, x, y, z axes par, aik doosre se 90° par (2.6.2).

blocks.prompt:
IX. How many d orbitals are there in a given energy level?
(Aik energy level mein kitne d orbitals hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: d ke liye ℓ = 2, to m = −2, −1, 0, +1, +2: paanch d orbitals (2ℓ + 1 = 5) (2.5.3).

blocks.prompt:
X. Which of the following species is predicted to have the highest bond order?
(Kis specie ka bond order sab se zyada hoga?)
blocks.explanation: MOT (Chapter 3, 3.6.1) se: bond order = (bonding − antibonding electrons)/2. N₂ = 3, O₂ = 2, F₂ = 1, Ne₂ = 0.

blocks.prompt:
XI. Which of the following species has a zero bond order according to MOT?
(MOT ke mutabiq kis specie ka bond order sifar (zero) hai?)
blocks.explanation: He₂: σ1s² σ*1s², bond order = (2 − 2)/2 = 0, is liye He₂ nahi banta (Chapter 3, 3.6.1). H₂⁺ = (1 − 0)/2 = ½; He₂⁺ = (2 − 1)/2 = ½; He₂²⁺ = (2 − 0)/2 = 1.

blocks.prompt:
XII. Which of the following molecular geometries has bond angles of approximately 120°?
(Kis molecular geometry mein bond angles taqreeban 120° hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Markazi atom ke gird teen bond pairs aur koi lone pair nahi: trigonal planar shakal, 120° angles, misal BF₃ (Chapter 3, 3.3.2). Tetrahedral 109.5°; pyramidal 107°; bent 120° ya 109.5° se kam.

blocks.text: Q.2 Darj zail sawalon ke mukhtasar jawab dein:

blocks.prompt:
a. There are three orientations of p-orbital due to three values of magnetic quantum number. Justify it.
Magnetic quantum number ki teen values ki wajah se p-orbital ke teen rukh hain. Sabit karein.
blocks.explanation: p subshell ke liye ℓ = 1, aur m ki (2ℓ + 1) = 3 values: −1, 0, +1. Har value aik orbital hai jis ka apna rukh hai: px, py, pz, x, y, z axes par, aik doosre ke amudi aur barabar energy wale (degenerate).

blocks.prompt:
b. Size of Mg is bigger than Al, but ionization energy of Mg is more than that of Al. Why?
Mg ka size Al se bara hai, phir bhi Mg ki ionization energy Al se zyada kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Mg (3s²) ka 3s subshell poora bhara aur mustahkam hai. Al (3s² 3p¹) ka akela 3p electron nikalta hai jo 3s se zyada energy rakhta hai aur 3s electrons use shield karte hain, is liye asani se nikalta hai. Is liye Mg ki IE > Al ki IE.

blocks.prompt:
c. ‘I₃’ of Mg is much bigger than its ‘I₂’. Justify.
Mg ki ‘I₃’ us ki ‘I₂’ se bohat zyada hai. Sabit karein.
blocks.explanation: Mg = 2, 8, 2. I₁ aur I₂ bahar ke shell ke do 3s electrons nikaalte hain. I₃ doosre shell (neon jaise mustahkam core ka 2p⁶) se electron nikaalti hai jo nucleus ke bohat qareeb aur kam shielded hai, aur woh bhi Mg²⁺ ion se. Is liye bari chhalang: I₃ ≫ I₂ (2.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
d. Among the elements Li, K, Ca, S and Kr which one has the lowest first ionization energy? Which has the highest first ionization.
Li, K, Ca, S aur Kr mein se kis ki pehli ionization energy sab se kam aur kis ki sab se zyada hai?
blocks.explanation:
Sab se kam: K, period 4 ka alkali metal (bara atom, aik 4s electron, zyada shielding).
Sab se zyada: Kr, noble gas jis ka 4s² 4p⁶ shell poora bhara hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Doosra sawal adhoora chhapa hai: "Which has the highest first ionization." mein "energy" aur sawaliya nishan nahi; murad hai "sab se zyada pehli ionization energy kis ki hai?"

blocks.prompt:
e. Consider the electronic configuration of the potassium atom (atomic number 19).
Potassium atom (atomic number 19) ki electronic configuration par ghaur karein.
blocks.explanation: Yeh neeche ke hisson (f) aur (g) ki tamheed hai. Potassium ke 19 electrons chaar shells mein: K 2, L 8, M 8, N 1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Items e se i tak alag harf (letters) ke saath chhape hain magar asal mein do sawalon ke hisse hain: e, f (i) aur g (ii) ki tamheed hai, aur h (i) aur i (ii) element X wale aik sawal ke do hisse hain.

blocks.prompt:
f. (i) Write the full electronic configuration of potassium using the s, p, d, f notation.
(i) s, p, d, f notation se potassium ki poori electronic configuration likhein.
blocks.explanation: ₁₉K = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 4s¹

blocks.prompt:
g. (ii) Explain why the 4s subshell is filled before the 3d subshell in potassium, even though the principal quantum number of the 3d subshell is lower.
(ii) Wazahat karein ke potassium mein 4s subshell 3d se pehle kyun bharta hai, halan ke 3d ka principal quantum number kam hai.
blocks.explanation: Aufbau principle ke mutabiq subshells energy ke barhte hue bharte hain, jo (n + ℓ) se maloom hoti hai: 4s = 4 + 0 = 4, 3d = 3 + 2 = 5. Kam (n + ℓ) yani kam energy, is liye 19wan electron 4s mein jata hai, 3d mein nahi.

blocks.prompt:
h. i) An atom of element X has an atomic number of 17 and a mass number of 35. Determine the number of protons, neutrons, and electrons in this atom.
i) Element X ka atomic number 17 aur mass number 35 hai. Is atom mein protons, neutrons aur electrons kitne hain?
blocks.explanation:
Protons = Z = 17
Neutrons = A − Z = 35 − 17 = 18
Electrons = 17 (neutral atom)

blocks.prompt:
i. (ii) If this element forms an ion with a charge of -1, how many protons, neutrons, and electrons will be present in the ion?
(ii) Agar yeh element −1 charge wala ion banaye to us mein protons, neutrons aur electrons kitne honge?
blocks.explanation:
X⁻ (Cl⁻ ki tarah) aik electron leta hai; nucleus nahi badalta:
Protons = 17
Neutrons = 18
Electrons = 17 + 1 = 18

blocks.prompt:
j. In the ground state of mercury ₈₀Hg:
i. How many electrons occupy atomic orbitals with n = 3?
ii. How many electrons occupy 4d atomic orbitals?
iii. How many electrons occupy 4pz atomic orbital?
iv. How many electrons have spin “up” (s = -½)?
Mercury ₈₀Hg ki ground state mein: i. n = 3 wale orbitals mein kitne electrons? ii. 4d mein kitne? iii. 4pz mein kitne? iv. kitne electrons ka spin "up" hai?
blocks.explanation:
₈₀Hg = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d¹⁰ 4s² 4p⁶ 4d¹⁰ 5s² 5p⁶ 4f¹⁴ 5d¹⁰ 6s²
i. n = 3: 3s² 3p⁶ 3d¹⁰ = 18 electrons (= 2n²)
ii. 4d: 10 electrons
iii. 4pz: 2 electrons (aik orbital mein zyada se zyada do)
iv. Tamam 80 electrons paired hain (har subshell bhara hai), is liye aadhe spin up: 40 electrons.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Hissa iv mein spin "up" ko s = -½ likha hai. Chapter (2.7 aur Table 2.6) mein oopar wala arrow (↑) s = +½ aur neeche wala (↓) s = −½ hai. Jawab (40) dono soorton mein wahi hai kyun ke Hg ke sab electrons paired hain.

blocks.prompt:
k. The successive ionization energies for an unknown element are
I₁ = 896 kJ/mol, I₂ = 1752 kJ/mol
I₃ = 14,807 kJ/mol, I₄ = 17,948 kJ/mol
To which family in the periodic table, does the unknown element most likely belong?
Aik na-maloom element ki lagataar ionization energies di gayi hain. Yeh element periodic table ki kis family se hai?
blocks.explanation: Bari chhalang I₂ (1752) aur I₃ (14,807) ke darmiyan hai, taqreeban 8 guna. Yani pehle do electrons valence shell se aur teesra andar ke shell se nikalta hai: element ke 2 valence electrons hain. Yeh group 2, alkaline earth metals ki family se hai (values beryllium se milti hain).

blocks.prompt:
l. Consider the following ionization energies for aluminum:
Al(g) → Al⁺(g) + e⁻   I₁ = 580 kJ/mol
Al⁺(g) → Al²⁺(g) + e⁻   I₂ = 1815 kJ/mol
Al²⁺(g) → Al³⁺(g) + e⁻   I₃ = 2740 kJ/mol
Al³⁺(g) → Al⁴⁺(g) + e⁻   I₄ = 11,600 kJ/mol
(i) Account for the trend in the values of the ionization energies.
(ii) Explain the large increase between I₃ and I₄.
(iii) List the four aluminum ions given in order of increasing size, and explain your ordering.
Aluminium ki di gayi ionization energies: (i) values ke trend ki wajah; (ii) I₃ aur I₄ ke darmiyan bari barhotri ki wajah; (iii) chaar aluminium ions ko size ke barhte hue tarteeb dein aur wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation:
(i) Har electron pehle se zyada positive ion se nikalta hai; wahi nuclear charge (+13) kam electrons ko pakarta hai, repulsion ghatti aur ion sukarta hai, is liye agla electron mushkil se nikalta hai: I₁ < I₂ < I₃ < I₄.
(ii) Al = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p¹. I₁, I₂, I₃ teen valence electrons (3p¹, 3s²) nikaalti hain. I₄ andar ke doosre shell (2p⁶, noble gas core) se electron nikaalti hai jo nucleus ke bohat qareeb aur kam shielded hai, is liye I₄ mein chhalang (11,600).
(iii) Al⁴⁺ < Al³⁺ < Al²⁺ < Al⁺. Wahi 13 protons aur kam electrons: repulsion kam aur har electron par kashish zyada, is liye zyada positive ion chhota; Al³⁺ aur Al⁴⁺ ka teesra shell bhi khatam ho chuka hai.

blocks.prompt:
m. (a) State the general order of filling orbitals up to the 4p subshell.
(b) Explain why the 4s subshell is filled before the 3d subshell, according to the Aufbau principle.
(a) 4p subshell tak orbitals bharne ki aam tarteeb likhein. (b) Aufbau principle ke mutabiq 4s, 3d se pehle kyun bharta hai?
blocks.explanation:
(a) 1s < 2s < 2p < 3s < 3p < 4s < 3d < 4p
(b) Subshells energy ke barhte hue bharte hain jo (n + ℓ) se maloom hoti hai: 4s = 4 + 0 = 4, 3d = 3 + 2 = 5. Kam (n + ℓ) yani kam energy, is liye 4s pehle bharta hai. (Jab (n + ℓ) barabar ho, jaise 3d aur 4p (dono 5), to kam n wala, 3d, pehle bharta hai.)

blocks.prompt:
n. Draw the orbital box diagram for the valence electrons of a phosphorus atom (atomic number 15), ensuring that your diagram adheres to Hund’s rule and the Pauli Exclusion Principle.
Phosphorus atom (atomic number 15) ke valence electrons ka orbital box diagram banayein jo Hund's rule aur Pauli Exclusion Principle ke mutabiq ho.
blocks.explanation:
₁₅P = 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p³; valence electrons 3s² 3p³.
3s ka aik box aur 3p ke teen boxes (3px, 3py, 3pz) banayein:
3s: [↑↓]   3p: [↑] [↑] [↑]
Pauli: do 3s electrons ke spin ulte hain. Hund: teen 3p electrons alag alag orbitals mein aik jaise spin ke saath (3 unpaired electrons, half-filled 3p).

blocks.prompt:
Q.3 What are quantum numbers? Describe briefly principal and spin quantum numbers.
Quantum numbers kya hain? Principal aur spin quantum numbers mukhtasar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Quantum numbers woh numbers hain jo orbital ka size, energy, shakal, space mein rukh aur us mein electron ka spin batate hain. Schrödinger ki wave equation teen (n, ℓ, m) deti hai; chautha (s) spin ke liye hai. Atom ke kisi do electrons ke chaaron quantum numbers aik jaise nahi hote (Pauli).
Principal quantum number (n):
1. Values 1, 2, 3, 4 … (shells K, L, M, N …), Bohr ke orbit number ke barabar.
2. Orbital ka size aur energy batata hai: n bara to electron nucleus se door, orbital bara aur energy zyada (kam mazbooti se bandha).
3. Shell aik jaise n wale orbitals ka majmooa hai; is mein zyada se zyada 2n² electrons (2, 8, 18, 32), n subshells aur n² orbitals hote hain.
Spin quantum number (s):
1. Electron apne axis par ghoomta hai; ghoomta charge magnetic field banata hai, is liye electron chhota magnet ban jata hai.
2. Do spin mumkin: clockwise, s = +½ (↑), aur anticlockwise, s = −½ (↓).
3. Teen quantum numbers orbital batate hain; chautha us ke do electrons mein farq karta hai. Aik orbital mein zyada se zyada do electrons, ulte spin ke saath (misal He: 1, 0, 0, +½ aur 1, 0, 0, −½).

blocks.prompt:
Q4. Draw the shapes of s, p and d-orbitals. Justify these by keeping in view the azimuthal and magnetic quantum numbers.
s, p aur d orbitals ki shaklein banayein aur azimuthal aur magnetic quantum numbers ki roshni mein inhein sabit karein.
blocks.explanation:
Azimuthal quantum number ℓ (0 se n − 1) shakal batata hai; magnetic quantum number m (−ℓ … 0 … +ℓ) orbitals ki tadaad (2ℓ + 1) aur un ka rukh batata hai.
s orbital (ℓ = 0, m = 0): aik orbital, gol (spherical). x, y, z axes ke markaz (nucleus) par aik gola banayein; har taraf electron density barabar. 2s, 1s se bara gola hai (bara gola, andar chhota gola).
p orbitals (ℓ = 1, m = −1, 0, +1): teen orbitals, dumb-bell shakal. Har aik nucleus par milte do lobes: px x axis par, py y axis par, pz z axis par; teenon aik doosre ke amudi aur barabar energy wale.
d orbitals (ℓ = 2, m = −2, −1, 0, +1, +2): paanch orbitals, zyada tar double dumb-bell (cloverleaf):
- dxy, dxz, dyz: chaar lobes xy, xz, yz planes mein, axes ke darmiyan.
- dx²−y²: chaar lobes x aur y axes par.
- dz²: z axis par do lobes aur xy plane mein doughnut jaisa chhalla.
Yun ℓ = 1 ki teen m values teen p rukh, aur ℓ = 2 ki paanch values paanch d rukh sabit karti hain; ℓ = 0 ki aik value hai, is liye s orbital ka koi khaas rukh nahi (gol).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Exam mein teen diagram banayein: (1) axes par gola = s; (2) teen alag axes par teen dumb-bells = px, py, pz (har aik par label aur m value); (3) paanch d orbitals: dxy, dyz, dxz (axes ke darmiyan chaar lobes), dx²−y² (axes par chaar lobes), dz² (z par do lobes aur beech mein chhalla).

blocks.prompt:
Q.5 What do you mean by successive ionization energies? How the electronic shell structure of magnesium (Mg) is derived from the successive ionization energies?
Successive (lagataar) ionization energies se kya muraad hai? Successive ionization energies se magnesium ki shell structure kaise maloom hoti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Successive ionization energies: atom ke electrons ko aik aik kar ke, tarteeb se, nikalne ki energies, yahan tak ke sirf nucleus reh jaye:
X → X⁺ + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₁
X⁺ → X²⁺ + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₂
X²⁺ → X³⁺ + e⁻   ΔHᵢ₃ …
Har agli pichli se bari hai kyun ke electron zyada positive ion se nikalta hai.
Mg (12 electrons) ki shell structure: bara successive ionization energies ka log₁₀ nikale gaye electrons ki tadaad ke muqable graph par:
1. Electron 1 aur 2 kam energy se nikalte hain: yeh bahar ke (teesre) shell mein hain.
2. Teesre electron par bari chhalang: do bahar ke electrons ke baad agla nucleus ke bohat qareeb wale shell se nikalta hai.
3. Electron 3 se 10 tak aahista barhotri: doosre shell ke aath electrons.
4. 11wen electron par doosri, aur bhi bari chhalang; electron 11 aur 12 nucleus ke sath wale pehle shell se.
Do bari chhalangein teen shells dikhati hain: Mg = 2, 8, 2 (1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s²).
